ai.title: Trump shares AI video of himself riding camel and holding face pizza
ai.description: Donald Trump shared an AI-generated music video on Truth Social featuring himself being celebrated around the world set to the song “Trump,” created by New York congressional candidate Anthony Constantino, who he recently endorsed. The video shows Trump holding a pizza topped with his own face, dining with Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum, parachuting through the sky, and riding a camel across a desert while dressed in a dark blue suit and red tie. Throughout the video, the song repeats the lyric: “Everywhere I go, they love Donald Donald Trump.” In a separate post, Trump shared an AI-generated image depicting the Obama Presidential Library deteriorating, surrounded by homeless encampments and topped with a large pile of garbage.
